faq.title: Before you buy
faq.note: If something is missing, ask on Discord: it gets answered before you buy, not after.

items.q: Do the scripts come with escrow?
items.a: Yes. They are sold with Cfx.re Asset Escrow, FiveM's official protection system. config.lua stays editable so you can adapt the resource to your server; the core is protected.

items.q: Is there one price for every script?
items.a: No. Each script has its own, published on its listing. If what you need is not in the catalog, custom work is quoted over Discord.

items.q: Does it work with Qbox or with a custom framework?
items.a: Every script lists the frameworks it was tested on. The framework layer is isolated in a single file, so adapting it to your own is a matter of filling in four functions.
From the same download link as your Tebex purchase, which always serves the latest version. Changes are announced in the changelog with the version and a note on whether the database needs touching.
They are handled through Tebex following [your refund policy]. As a digital product, the norm is no refunds unless the script does not work and cannot be fixed.

items.q: Do you install it for me?
items.a: A standard install is something anyone can do by following the documentation. If you would rather I did it, or you need a specific integration, we agree that separately.

performance.title: How we measure performance
performance.text: Every script is measured with resmon 1 on a clean server: first idle, with the resource loaded and nothing on screen, then in the worst case expected in production. Both figures are published, never an average. If it goes over 0.05 ms idle, it does not go on sale.

items.title: Licence terms
items.text: Every purchase includes a licence for one production server. Scripts ship with Cfx.re Asset Escrow: you can edit config.lua and any files left open; the rest is protected by Cfx.re. Reselling, redistributing or publishing the resource is not allowed, in whole or in part. For networks with several IPs or custom work, arrange it on Discord.

items.title: Terms
items.text: The sale, the payment and the invoice are handled by Tebex from the store, so buying also means accepting their terms. Delivery is automatic once payment clears. Newer versions are downloaded from the same Tebex purchase link.

items.title: Privacy
items.text: This site is static: no accounts, no forms, no analytics and no cookies of our own. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which sees your IP when serving them. Payment data is handled by Tebex and support happens on Discord: nothing about you is stored here.
